title: Russian aviation’s losing streak continues, with three aircraft and their crews lost near St Petersburg (Ukraine Battlefield update, Day 1,723)
lede: A night that cost Russia three of its own aircraft, a Ukrainian pilot felling nine drones with a single F-16 sortie, and a supposed humanitarian corridor that could help Moscow tighten its grip on Kostiantynivka together paint a war where every tactical success hides a dangerous twist.
